reviewer: Two Codex agents reviewed the overview and enlarged category sheets; replacement octagons inspected at larger scale.
selection_goal: Ten useful structural pilot examples per requested prompt, with tracing irregularity, gaps, overlaps, aspect variation and multiple strokes; plain undecorated crescents only for moon.
selection_bias: Curated positive examples from a bounded first-2,000-record prefix and 48 hash-selected candidates per category; not a prevalence estimate or statistical population sample. Prompt/recognized are context metadata, never structural ground truth.
excluded_examples: Moon full circles, craters, stars, text and extra objects; other obvious multi-object or unrelated scribbles. Rejected data remains in candidate records.
